notes.title: 【Update】Update & Difficulty Level Adjustment
notes.content:
The following fixes and adjustments have been made:

・Slightly reduced the speed of normal pitches in Stage7
・Increased the number of pitches in Stage7
・Slightly reduced the speed of normal pitches in Stage8
・Added TIPS to Stage10
・Reduced the boss's HP in StageC

notes.title: 【Update】Update & Bug fix +3
notes.content:
The following fixes have been made

・Fixed an issue in StageFinal where balls deflected by Black Hole Bomber did not deal damage.
・Fixed the behavior when hitting a stationary ball again after it's been stopped in StageD.
・The staff credits after clearing Stage8 can now be skipped by pressing the ESC key.
・Fixed an issue where the NOMISS state was not removed after finishing a run in Challenge Mode.

Additional Fix
・TIPS are now displayed in Stage 4.
・Added a marker to indicate the maximum achievement rate for each stage.
・Fixed an issue where the Stage8 boss would occasionally explode and become weakened. This explosion does not occur in Challenge Mode.

notes.title: 【Major Update】He’s back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540477/c24265eab5290141fc62a9386c9aa426319b3857.png[/img]
The final battle begins now…!
Major Update “Return of KUSOGAKI” is live!

Various elements have been adjusted for a smoother experience.
Challenging stages await in the latter half of the game.
Can you conquer them all?
And who—or what—is the returning KUSOGAKI?

[h2]Additions & Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Core behavior and display adjustments
[*]New stages added from Stage 9 onward (use waist shift to go up)
[*]New achievements
[*]New Challenge Mode
[*]Balance changes to existing stages
[/list]

[h2]Note[/h2]
Take a break if you're tired.

[h2]For players who played before the update[/h2]
Overall, the difficulty of earlier stages has been lowered.
[list]
[*]Stage 6 (Squid) has new behavior. Stage 8 has also been adjusted. Some goal points in other stages were modified as well.
[*]The base power of the bat should be stronger than before.
[*]Tutorial content has been added to Stages 1–3.
If you're not sure how to hit the ball far, Stage 3's tutorial covers the key info.
Mash Restart to begin the tutorial.
[/list]

We’ve also prepared a small celebration for those who clear the new hard stages for the first time.
If you beat Stage [strike]EX2[/strike] or Stage KUSO, let us know—
and send proof via video!

notes.title: uPDATE (final adjustment before the stage addition update)
notes.content:
Unless there are any major issues, this will likely be the final adjustment before the stage addition update.

・Removed the Swan
・Adjusted the clear score requirement for Stage 7 from 1400 points to 1200 points
・Fixed the mouse movement detection when activating the Secret Technique "Charismatic Arrival"
・Fixed a bug where the Secret Technique "Surging Bat" would trigger unexpectedly under certain conditions
・Adjusted the game to display the acquisition text when returning to the stage select screen after obtaining a Secret Technique

notes.title: [Update Preview] It's Coming Back... Again
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540477/11e0aaf403b522d4eb229084aaf5b2d7bb45e915.png[/img]

We're making Hard Mode (from Stage 9 onward)!
Up to Stage 8, we balanced the game to keep it fun and light.
But after this update... who knows what will happen?

Release Date: TBD

Due to other plans, it might be a while.
It'll probably show up one day when you've forgotten all about it!

notes.title: 【Update】New Secret Technique and more
notes.content:
・The default setting is now based on the "Mouse Boost Setting", and the "Normal Mode" has been changed to "Super Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball".
When starting a new game, it will begin with the Mouse Boost Setting enabled.

・Added a new Secret Technique: "Surging Bat".

・After clearing the game with an S rank five times, the Trick Bat will evolve.

・Fixed a bug where configuration values would change when opening or closing the menu.

notes.title: 【Update】Insane Achievement
notes.content:
The following changes have been made:

・Fixed an issue where the "Insane Achievement" could not be unlocked when using Mouse Boost. (Now unlockable both in-game and on Steam)

・Adjusted the wording in the Mouse Boost Settings menu.

・Fixed a bug where the effect did not display correctly when the ball of the 1st Cosmic Velocity split during the Secret Technique "Breaking Ball: Split".

notes.title: Update (Giant Ball, TIPS, stage8)
notes.content:
The following adjustments have been made:

・Increased the visibility of the tip shown only in Stage 1

notes.title: Update, Modified so that the Secret Technique
notes.content:
We have made the following changes:
The activation method for the Secret Technique "Maximum Burning" has been mainly adjusted. Accordingly, movement by mouse click has been removed. The game can now only be controlled using the WASD keys.

・Text corrections
・Removal of movement via mouse click and mouse wheel
・Modified so that the Secret Technique "Maximum Burning" can also be activated by continuously scrolling the mouse wheel upward

notes.title: Update & BUG Burst
notes.content:
We have fixed bugs and revised some text.

・A bug where Steam achievements were not being unlocked
・Text corrections

notes.title: Most Dangerous Update
notes.content:
We’ve made several updates focused on reducing the graphic load.
If your system is struggling to run the game, please give these a try.
And if it’s still heavy, feel free to let us know.

・Implemented Performance Saver
　From the title screen, go to Performance Saver and select Lightweight Version.
　This simplifies particularly heavy effects, such as explosions.

・Added Prettier Screen setting
　This can be adjusted from the in-game menu.
　It lets you fine-tune additive blending effects.
　If the visuals are too bright or you want better performance, try setting it to 0.

・Increased the bat’s hitbox size for mighty boss

・Adjusted Rank Requirements (Pitches) for Stage 3

・Slightly eased power scaling up to 1st Cosmic Velocity

notes.title: Update Big Nice
notes.content:
We’ve made several adjustments, mainly around the Mouse Boost feature.
This should improve compatibility with a wider range of mice.
If you still feel something’s off, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Fixed Mouse Sensitivity settings in the menu screen.
Sensitivity is now split into Mouse Sensitivity (Vertical) and Mouse Sensitivity (Horizontal).

Further relaxed the activation conditions for the Secret Technique “Maximum Burning” when using Mouse Boost.
If you’re still having trouble activating it, try moving your mouse slowly upward.
Some non-gaming mice may fail to register extremely fast movements.

Buffed the Mouse Boost mode so that you can now fight alongside the legendary swan.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
We’ve made the following adjustments as a quick fix:

・Increased vertical speed in Mouse Boost Settings
・Adjusted “Maximum Burning” in Mouse Boost Settings to trigger more easily
・Made the red “!” warning icon in the menu more noticeable
・Increased the default meat speed at game start

We’re planning an upcoming update that will allow fine-tuning of mouse aim speed for vertical movement only.
If you encounter any other issues or have feedback, feel free to let us know.

Until then, happy arm-swinging!
